text:
incident-bot: PIR required for INC-5621 (P2 -> mitigation in place). Please nominate facilitator + backup, confirm attendees, and commit to pre-read owners within 72h. timeline+logs: https://redwood.in/incident/INC-5621

devon: I can facilitate but traveling Thu morning PST. available Tue/Wed mornings PST or Wed late UTC.

priya: I can back up and run the action tracker. prefer Wed 14:00 UTC but can shift. will own pre-read draft.

sarah: CS rep here — I’ll prepare the customer impact summary and any quotes. need the pre-read by EOD Mon to coordinate with the customer rep.

reno: infra lead — I’ll present the mitigation steps and open tasks. TTs for any infra owners: @devops-team please flag conflicts.

devon: OK, looks like Wed 17:00 UTC works for most. priya as backup facilitator. anna can take notes?

anna: I can take notes and own action item capture. will surface owners + due dates in the doc.

priya: putting a minimal agenda in the repo now. add anything obvious.

priya: ```
Agenda:
1) Timeline recap (10m) - devon
2) What went wrong (15m) - engineering
3) Mitigation & rollback details (10m) - reno
4) Customer impact & comms (10m) - sarah
5) Action items & owners (15m) - anna/priya
6) Follow-ups and verification plan (10m)
```

devon: pls include the canary rollback note under mitigation and a short snippet of the deploy commands we ran: `kubectl rollout undo` + image tag used.

priya: noted. I’ll add the command snippet and an excerpt from the logs. will post pre-read draft by tomorrow 18:00 UTC (which is 10:00 PDT).

calendar-bot: Tentative event created: "Post-incident review - INC-5621" Wed 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC. RSVP required. Event link: https://calendar.redwood/events/INC-5621-pir

devon: backup confirmed: priya. anna is nil? thanks anna. can we also invite the customer success manager who spoke to the customer (sarah will add).

sarah: adding CSM and the account owner to the invite. I’ll also attach the customer timeline doc to the calendar event once pre-read is up.

reno: quick ask — infra needs 48h lead time to run the postmortem debug job and extract traces. priya/anna pls note as an action.

anna: action: infra debug extraction — owner reno — due in 48h. action: pre-read draft — owner priya — due tomorrow 18:00 UTC. action: note-taking + action table — owner anna — will publish after the meeting.

incident-bot: severity updated to P3 in follow-up note but PIR stands. Please react with :thumbsup: when you’ve accepted facilitator/attendance.

sarah: :thumbsup:

anna: :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup: I’ll post the pre-read link here when ready.

devon: thanks all — if anything changes to availability shout here. otherwise we’ll finalize invite and pre-read per the owners above.

calendar-bot: Reminder set: pre-read due 24h prior, auto-attach to event when posted to /incidents/INC-5621/pre-read.md

priya: uploaded draft pre-read: https://repo.redwood/incidents/INC-5621/pre-read.md — please review; I marked the sections I want SME input on.

reno: grabbing logs now. will paste the extraction link into the doc when ready.

anna: closing loop: facilitator devon, backup priya, note-taker anna, attendees set (eng, infra, CS, ops). meeting confirmed Wed 17:00 UTC.

devon: perfect. see you all then.
